title: UK companies need more effective boards of directors

sentences.en: A. After a number of serious failures of governance (that is, how they are managed at the highest level), companies in Britain, as well as elsewhere, should consider radical changes to their directors' roles.
sentences.zh: 答：在经历了一系列严重的治理失败（即最高层的管理方式）之后,英国以及其他地方的公司应该考虑对其董事的角色进行根本性的改变。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It is clear that the role of a board director today is not an easy one.
sentences.zh: 显然,当今董事会董事的角色并不容易。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Following the 2008 financial meltdown, which resulted in a deeper and more prolonged period of economic downturn than anyone expected, the search for explanations in the many post-mortems of the crisis has meant blame has been spread far and wide.
sentences.zh: 2008 年金融危机导致了比任何人预想的更严重、更持久的经济衰退,在对危机的许多事后分析中寻找解释意味着指责已经广泛传播。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Governments, regulators, central banks and auditors have all been in the frame.
sentences.zh: 政府、监管机构、中央银行和审计师都在框架内。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The role of bank directors and management and their widely publicised failures have been extensively picked over and examined in reports, inquiries and commentaries.
sentences.zh: 银行董事和管理层的角色及其广为人知的失败已在报告、质询和评论中被广泛挑选和审查。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: B. The knock-on effect of this scrutiny has been to make the governance of companies in general an issue of intense public debate and has significantly increased the pressures on, and the responsibilities of, directors.
sentences.zh: B. 这种审查的连锁反应使公司治理总体上成为公众激烈辩论的问题,并显着增加了董事的压力和责任。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: At the simplest and most practical level, the time involved in fulfilling the demands of a board directorship has increased significantly, calling into question the effectiveness of the classic model of corporate governance by part-time, independent non-executive directors.
sentences.zh: 从最简单和最实际的层面来看,履行董事会董事职责所需的时间显着增加,这使人们对兼职独立非执行董事的经典公司治理模式的有效性产生了质疑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Where once a board schedule may have consisted of between eight and ten meetings a year, in many companies the number of events requiring board input and decisions has dramatically risen.
sentences.zh: 曾经,董事会日程表每年可能包含八到十次会议,但在许多公司中,需要董事会意见和决策的事件数量急剧增加。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the amount of reading and preparation required for each meeting is increasing.
sentences.zh: 此外,每次会议所需的阅读和准备量也在增加。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Agendas can become overloaded and this can mean the time for constructive debate must necessarily be restricted in favour of getting through the business.
sentences.zh: 议程可能会变得超负荷,这可能意味着必须限制建设性辩论的时间,以利于完成业务。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: C. Often, board business is devolved to committees in order to cope with the workload, which may be more efficient but can mean that the board as a whole is less involved in fully addressing some of the most important issues.
sentences.zh: C. 通常,董事会业务会被下放给委员会以应对工作量,这可能会更有效率,但可能意味着董事会作为一个整体较少参与全面解决一些最重要的问题。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It is not uncommon for the audit committee meeting to last longer than mainboard meeting itself.
sentences.zh: 审计委员会会议的持续时间比主板会议本身更长的情况并不罕见。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Process may take the place of discussion and be at the expense of real collaboration, so that boxes are ticked rather than issues tackled.
sentences.zh: 流程可能会取代讨论,并以牺牲真正的协作为代价,因此只勾选方框而不是解决问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: D. A radical solution, which may work for some very large companies whose businesses are extensive and complex, is the professional board, whose members would work up to three or four days a week, supported by their own dedicated staff and advisers.
sentences.zh: D. 一个激进的解决方案可能适用于一些业务广泛且复杂的非常大的公司,那就是专业委员会,其成员每周工作三到四天,并得到自己专门的员工和顾问的支持。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There are obvious risks to this and it would be important to establish clear guidelines for such a board to ensure that it did not step on the toes of management by becoming too engaged in the day-to-day running of the company.
sentences.zh: 这存在明显的风险,为这样的董事会制定明确的指导方针非常重要,以确保其不会因过度参与公司的日常运营而触怒管理层。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Problems of recruitment, remuneration, and independence could also arise and this structure would not be appropriate for all companies.
sentences.zh: 招聘、薪酬和独立性问题也可能出现,这种结构并不适合所有公司。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, more professional and better-informed boards would have been particularly appropriate for banks where the executives had access to information that part-time non-executive directors lacked, leaving the latter unable to comprehend or anticipate the 2008 crash.
sentences.zh: 然而,更专业、更消息灵通的董事会尤其适合银行,因为高管们可以获得兼职非执行董事所缺乏的信息,从而使后者无法理解或预测 2008 年的崩盘。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: E. One of the main criticisms of boards and their directors is that they do not focus sufficiently on longer-term matters of strategy, sustainability and governance, but instead concentrate too much on short-term financial metrics.
sentences.zh: E. 对董事会及其董事的主要批评之一是,他们没有充分关注战略、可持续性和治理等长期问题,而是过于关注短期财务指标。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Regulatory requirements and the structure of the market encourage this behaviour.
sentences.zh: 监管要求和市场结构鼓励这种行为。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The tyranny of quarterly reporting can distort board decision-making, as directors have to 'make the numbers' every four months to meet the insatiable appetite of the market for more data.
sentences.zh: 季度报告的专制可能会扭曲董事会的决策,因为董事必须每四个月“制作一次数据”,以满足市场对更多数据的贪得无厌的胃口。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This serves to encourage the trading methodology of a certain kind of investor who moves in and out of a stock without engaging in constructive dialogue with the company about strategy or performance, and is simply seeking a short term financial gain.
sentences.zh: 这有助于鼓励某种投资者的交易方法,他们在没有与公司就策略或业绩进行建设性对话的情况下进出股票,而只是寻求短期财务收益。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This effect has been made worse by the changing profile of investors due to the globalisation of capital and the increasing use of automated trading systems.
sentences.zh: 由于资本全球化和自动交易系统的日益使用,投资者形象的变化加剧了这种影响。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Corporate culture adapts and management teams are largely incentivised to meet financial goals.
sentences.zh: 企业文化不断适应,管理团队在很大程度上受到激励以实现财务目标。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F. Compensation for chief executives has become a combat zone where pitched battles between investors, management and board members are fought, often behind closed doors but increasingly frequently in the full glare of press attention.
sentences.zh: F. 首席执行官的薪酬已经成为投资者、管理层和董事会成员之间激烈争斗的战场,这些争斗通常是闭门进行的,但越来越频繁地在媒体的关注下展开。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Many would argue that this is in the interest of transparency and good governance as shareholders use their muscle in the area of pay to pressure boards to remove underperforming chief executives.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为,这有利于透明度和良好治理,因为股东利用他们在薪酬领域的影响力向董事会施压,要求其罢免表现不佳的首席执行官。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Their powers to vote down executive remuneration policies increased when binding votes came into force.
sentences.zh: 当具有约束力的投票生效时,他们投票否决高管薪酬政策的权力增加了。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The chair of the remuneration committee can be an exposed and lonely role, as Alison Carnwath, chair of Barclays Bank's remuneration committee, found when she had to resign, having been roundly criticised for trying to defend the enormous bonus to be paid to the chief executive; the irony being that she was widely understood to have spoken out against it in the privacy of the committee.
sentences.zh: 薪酬委员会主席可能是一个暴露而孤独的角色,正如巴克莱银行薪酬委员会主席艾莉森·卡恩沃斯(Alison Carnwath)在不得不辞职时发现的那样,她因试图捍卫支付给首席执行官的巨额奖金而受到严厉批评；讽刺的是,人们普遍认为她在委员会私下里公开反对这一做法。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: G. The financial crisis stimulated a debate about the role and purpose of the company and a heightened awareness of corporate ethics.
sentences.zh: G. 金融危机引发了关于公司的角色和目的的辩论以及企业道德意识的提高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Trust in the corporation has been eroded and academics such as Michael Sandel, in his thoughtful and bestselling book What Money Can't Buy, are questioning the morality of capitalism and the market economy.
sentences.zh: 对公司的信任已经被削弱,迈克尔·桑德尔（Michael Sandel）等学者在他深思熟虑的畅销书《钱买不到什么》中质疑资本主义和市场经济的道德。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Boards of companies in all sectors will need to widen their perspective to encompass these issues and this may involve a realignment of corporate goals.
sentences.zh: 所有行业的公司董事会都需要拓宽视野以涵盖这些问题,这可能涉及公司目标的重新调整。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: We live in challenging times.
sentences.zh: 我们生活在充满挑战的时代。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

questions.title: Questions 27-40
instructions: Questions 27-33: Reading Passage 3 has seven paragraphs, A-G.
Questions 34-37 : Do the following statements agree with the claims of the writer in Reading Passage 3?
Questions 38-40 : Complete the sentences below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer. Write your answers in boxes 38-40 on your answer sheet.

items.prompt: Close scrutiny of the behavior of boards has increased since the economic downturn.
Banks have been mismanaged to a greater extent than other businesses.
Board meetings normally continue for as long as necessary to debate matters in full.
Using a committee structure would ensure that board members are fully informed about significant issues.
Before 2008, non-executive directors were at a disadvantage because of their lack of …
Boards tend to place too much emphasis on … considerations that are only of short-term relevance.
On certain matters, such as pay, the board may have to accept the views of …
